unusual_experiment.question: Does PR #764's exact head actually implement its stated correction that verified-empty windows still traverse inference/persistence?
unusual_experiment.observation: No. Before repair, exact branch mini_entity_part04.inc returned immediately when packet.n==0, while the canonical BLOGPOST_ENTITY.clay has no pre-inference empty-window shortcut and the PR body itself says the shortcut was removed.
unusual_experiment.repair: Removed the packet.n==0 early return. Verified-empty windows now continue through canonical compile -> inference -> gate -> commit, are reported quiet=true, and advance generation. The runtime guard test now requires two runner invocations, generation 2, two outputs and two study rows across eventful then verified-empty cycles.
unusual_experiment.evidence_scope: SOURCE-BOUND REPAIR ONLY; executable credit remains open until an admitted runner actually executes the updated head.
